says: The lint rule fabrika/no-of lets a shorthand destructure 'const { of } = Lease' pass, though it binds a bare local named of just as 'import { of }' does, which the same rule refuses.
proof: no-of.ts:98 skips every shorthand property in an ObjectPattern; no-of.ts:192 reports 'import { of }'. A file under next/ with 'const { of } = Lease;' and 'const colorsOf = of;' under oxlint with the repo's .oxlintrc.json reports only line 5 (colorsOf, fabrika(no-of)); line 4 gets nothing. A file with only the destructure exits 0. A file with 'import { of } from "./x.ts";' reports fabrika(no-of) at 1:10. no-of.test.ts has no destructured-of case.
cost: Code in next/ can read a module's of as a bare of with a destructure, the exact shape 0029 bans, and lint stays green.
